title: 1912 John McLauchlan Co. prior to Hartland Clothing Com
description: In 1904, John MacLauchlan Co. Ltd. of Woodstock opened a Hartland branch specializing in men’s and boys’ clothing, with A. G. Baker as manager. The business originally operated out of the Burtt Building on upper Main Street (later known as Stedmans and Alumico). In 1908, after a new brick building was constructed, the store relocated to its new home, as seen in this picture. Arthur Dickinson joined Baker, and together they eventually bought out MacLauchlan. With Rex York later joining the partnership, they established the Hartland Clothing Company. In 1920, they built a new white-faced building beside the brick building, and later the Farmer Co-op Store on Main Street.
